item.title: Mapping Digital Connectivity Gaps to Guide Infrastructure Investment in East Africa
item.description: Where should digital infrastructure investment go first? The African Development Bank (AfDB) is combining Ookla® connectivity data with population and social infrastructure data to identify digital connectivity gaps and support investment prioritization across 11 East African countries — Burundi, Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Tanzania and Uganda.
